invitation.heading: You have been invited to join {schoolName}
invitation.body: You have been invited to join {schoolName} on the platform.
invitation.footer: Automated message sent by {schoolName}. If you were not expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.

invitationReminder.subject: Reminder: your invitation to join {schoolName}
invitationReminder.heading: Your invitation to {schoolName} is waiting
invitationReminder.body: Your invitation to join {schoolName} has not been used yet. The previous link has been replaced, so only this one works.
invitationReminder.expiry: This new link expires in 48 hours.
invitationReminder.footer: Automated message sent by {schoolName}. If you were not expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.

passwordChanged.subject: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.heading: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.body: The password for your account was just changed. No action is needed if you made this change.
passwordChanged.notice: Your other open sessions remain active.
passwordChanged.footer: Automated message. If you did not make this change, reset your password immediately and contact an administrator.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your password
resetPassword.preheader: Reset link valid for one hour.
resetPassword.heading: Reset your password
resetPassword.body: A password reset was requested for this account. Use the button below to choose a new one.
resetPassword.footer: Automated message. If you did not request this, ignore this email: your current password remains valid.

setPassword.subject: Set your password
setPassword.preheader: Password setup link valid for one hour.
setPassword.heading: Set your password
setPassword.body: Access to the platform is ready for {email}, but no password has been set yet. Use the button below to choose yours and sign in.
setPassword.notice: This link expires in 1 hour. After that, use “Forgot password” on the sign-in page to get a new one.
setPassword.footer: Automated message. If you were not expecting this access, ignore this email: no password will be set.

verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email address
verifyEmail.preheader: One step left to confirm your address.
verifyEmail.heading: Confirm your email address
verifyEmail.body: This address was entered for the account {email}. Confirming it ensures platform messages — invitations, password resets — reach you.
verifyEmail.notice: Without confirmation, this link remains the only way to validate the address.
verifyEmail.footer: Automated message. If you did not request this, ignore this email.

changeEmail.subject: Confirm your email address change
changeEmail.heading: Confirm the address change
changeEmail.body: A request to replace {email} with {newEmail} was recorded for this account.
changeEmail.bodyCurrentAddress: This message is sent to the current address: without this confirmation, the account address stays unchanged.
changeEmail.notice: After confirmation, you will sign in with {newEmail}.
changeEmail.footer: Automated message. If you did not request this, ignore this email and change your password.

preview.title: Preview.
preview.description: This page is hidden from the public ({status}, {visibility}).

pwa.offline: Connection lost. An Internet connection is required to save your changes.
pwa.updateDescription: Finish your edits before reloading the application.

install.title: Add to Home Screen
install.stepAdd: Choose “Add to Home Screen”, then tap Add.
